article.title: COP31 Climate Summit Achieves Historic 1.5°C Binding Commitment
article.description: All G20 nations signed a legally binding agreement to limit global warming to 1.5°C, with a $100 billion annual climate fund for developing nations and coal phase-out by 2035.
article.author: Sarah Mitchell

article.title: NASA-ISRO Mars Mission Successfully Enters Martian Orbit
article.description: Joint NASA-ISRO mission MARS-2025 achieved Martian orbit insertion after 7 months, carrying ground-penetrating radar to map subsurface water and advanced atmospheric spectrometers.
article.author: James Rodriguez

article.title: UN Adopts First Legally Binding Global AI Governance Treaty
article.description: All 193 UN member states unanimously adopted the Global AI Governance Framework, requiring national AI safety boards, algorithmic transparency, and a permanent ban on autonomous lethal weapons.
article.author: Emma Thompson

article.title: Global Hunger Index 2025: 735 Million Face Acute Food Insecurity
article.description: The 2025 Global Hunger Index reveals 735 million people face acute food insecurity, with Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia most affected by climate-related crop failures and ongoing conflicts.
article.author: Fatima Al-Hassan

article.title: BRICS+ Expands to 15 Members, Launches Common Digital Trade Currency
article.description: BRICS+ now represents 15 nations and 46% of global GDP. The bloc launched BRICS Pay, a digital trade currency framework to reduce US dollar dependence in international commerce.
article.author: Chen Wei
